references.text: Aaron and his sons were chosen for priestly service, establishing the priestly responsibility mentioned in Numbers 18:1
Aaron shall bear the guilt of the sanctuary, which directly relates to the responsibility of bearing the iniquity of the sanctuary
The priests received the sin offering to bear the guilt of the congregation, relating to bearing the iniquity of the sanctuary
The Levites were appointed to serve at the tabernacle and prevent wrath from falling on the assembly of Israel, complementing the priests' responsibility
Aaron and his sons were appointed to carry out the priestly service, confirming their unique responsibility
The people's fear of dying by approaching the tabernacle is the background for why Aaron and his descendants must bear the responsibility
The Levites shall bear their iniquity, reflecting the concept of bearing guilt connected to sanctuary service
The high priest was appointed to present offerings and sacrifices for sins, fulfilling the principle of bearing the iniquity of the sanctuary
Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many, which is the perfect fulfillment of the priest's role in bearing guilt
